data_objects.name: hourly_weather_observations
data_objects.meaning: Timestamped surface-weather measurements including wind, air temperature, pressure, humidity, and visibility fields.
data_objects.notes: Blank CSV cells represent unavailable measurements.

variables.name: DATE TIME
variables.meaning: Date and clock time of the weather observation.

variables.name: DIR
variables.meaning: Wind direction encoded as a numeric azimuth.

structure.description: Each row is a timestamped weather observation; the DATE TIME values are ordered chronologically at hourly cadence.
Empty CSV fields are the observed missing-value encoding for measurement columns.

uncertainties: The station or location, time zone, and observation convention are not identified.
The units of wind speed, gust speed, air temperature, barometric pressure, relative humidity, and visibility are not stated; numeric values alone do not resolve them.
The distinction between sustained WINDSPEED and GUSTS sampling intervals is not supplied.
annotation_notes: Only train.csv was declared as evidence; leading spaces in source column names are preserved exactly.
